## Introduction

Vuetify is a semantic component framework for Vue. It aims to provide clean, semantic and reusable components that make building your application a breeze.

Build *amazing* applications with the power of Vue and Material Design and a massive library of beautifully crafted components. Created according to Google's **<a href="https://example.invalid/" target="_blank">Material Design Spec</a>**, Vuetify components feature an easy-to-remember semantic design that shifts remembering complex classes and markup, to type-as-you speak properties that have simple and clear names.

Harness the power of the [Vuetify community](https://example.invalid) and get help 24/7 from the development team and our talented community members across the world. Become a [backer](https://example.invalid/vuetify) and get access to dedicated support from the team.

### Browser Support

Vuetify supports all **modern browsers**, including IE11 and Safari 9+ (using polyfills). From mobile to laptop to desktop, you can rest assured that your application will work as expected. Interested in the bleeding edge? Try the vue-cli Webpack SSR (Server side rendered) template and build websites optimized for SEO.

## One minute Quick-start

[Codepen link](https://example.invalid/johnjleider/pen/jYZwVZ)
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <link href='https://example.invalid/css?family=Roboto:300,400,500,700|Material+Icons' rel="stylesheet">
  <link href="https://example.invalid/vuetify/dist/vuetify.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, minimal-ui">
</head>
<body>
  <div id="app">
    <v-app>
      <v-content>
        <v-container>Hello world</v-container>
      </v-content>
    </v-app>
  </div>

  <script src="https://example.invalid/vue/dist/vue.js"></script>
  <script src="https://example.invalid/vuetify/dist/vuetify.js"></script>
  <script>
    new Vue({
      el: '#app'
    })
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

## Installation

``` bash
# npm
npm install vuetify
```

``` bash
# yarn
yarn add vuetify
```

## Usage

```javascript
import Vue from 'vue'
import Vuetify from 'vuetify'

Vue.use(Vuetify)
```

For including styles, you can either place the below styles in your `index.html`
```html
<link href='https://example.invalid/css?family=Roboto:300,400,500,700|Material+Icons' rel="stylesheet">
<link href="https://example.invalid/vuetify/dist/vuetify.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
```
Or you can import it to your webpack entry point
```javascript
require('https://example.invalid/css?family=Roboto:300,400,500,700|Material+Icons')
require('/path/to/node_modules/vuetify/dist/vuetify.min.css')
```
Keep in mind, you will need to ensure your webpack config contains a <a href="https://example.invalid/webpack-contrib/css-loader" target="_blank">css loader</a>.

## Contributing

Developers interested in contributing should read the [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

> Please do **not** ask general questions in an issue. Issues are only to report bugs, request
  enhancements, or request new features. For general questions and discussions, ask on the [Vuetify Discord Community](https://example.invalid/).

It is important to note that for each release, the detailed changes are documented in the [release notes](https://example.invalid/vuetifyjs/vuetify/releases).

### Contributing Guide

You can report issues by following the [Issue Template](https://example.invalid/) and you can create a minimal reproduction with a [CodePen template](https://example.invalid/) or a full project at [CodeSandbox](https://example.invalid/s/vue).

### Good First Issue

To help you get you familiar with our contribution process, we have a list of [good first issues](https://example.invalid/vuetifyjs/vuetify/labels/good%20first%20issue) that contain bugs which have a relatively limited scope. This is a great place to get started.

We also have a list of [help wanted](https://example.invalid/vuetifyjs/vuetify/labels/help%20wanted) issues that you might want to check.
